summary: Elevra Lithium filed a 6-K furnishing two ASX announcements: an AGM notice and an update on the proposed sale of its Ewoyaa Lithium Project interests in Ghana to Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt for about US$71M cash, before fees and taxes, per the 11 May 2026 agreement. Huayou has obtained FIRB approval for its separate Atlantic Lithium scheme. Completion awaits Ghanaian Government approvals; if not obtained by 30 October 2026, Huayou may complete or terminate and pay a US$5M break fee, with no fee if Ghana rejects. Watch the approval deadline and break-fee optionality.
